\item \textit{Notes:} Ho et al. (2024) preferred specification (model 7): log perplexity $= \exp(\alpha_{\text{const}}^{b} - \alpha_{\text{year}}(t-t_0) - \alpha_{\text{param}}\ln(N/N_0)) + \exp(\beta_{\text{const}}^{b} - \beta_{\text{year}}(t-t_0) - \beta_{\text{data}}\ln(D/D_0))$, benchmark $b\in\{$WT103, PTB, WT2$\}$, irreducible loss set to zero. Estimator: mean squared residual plus $0.0025\sum|\theta|$, SLSQP from $\theta=0$, exactly as in the authors' code (commit 29c7d85). $n=231$ model--benchmark rows from 144 papers (top three models per paper). Objective at optimum 0.0518129 (authors: 0.0518129); largest absolute parameter difference 4.0e-07. Columns 5, 6 and 8 are 95\% bootstrap percentile intervals: iid resampling of rows with the authors' random-number sequence (\texttt{np.random.seed(0)}; $B=100$ is their protocol), and resampling of papers (clusters, 400 draws). $T_C=\ln 2/(\alpha_{\text{year}}/\alpha_{\text{param}}+\beta_{\text{year}}/\beta_{\text{data}})$ is the effective-compute doubling time (months); the published headline (8.4 months) is the bootstrap median, whereas the point estimate is 8.68 months. $T_C$ intervals: percentiles of $T_C$ for the authors' protocol (as in their code), otherwise percentiles of $g_C$ mapped to $T_C$ (a draw with $g_C\le 0$ has an infinite doubling time; 4 of 400 converged cluster draws). Converged: identical objective and algorithm with SLSQP run to convergence (tolerance $10^{-13}$ instead of the scipy default $10^{-6}$ used by the authors' code); bootstrap draws start at zero and at the full-sample optimum and keep the lower objective. The last two rows split the objective into its fit (MSE) and penalty parts.
